CONFIG_PAGE.TITLE: Global Configuration
CONFIG_PAGE.SUBTITLE: Manage global engine settings, PKI certificates, and transaction policies
CONFIG_PAGE.PANEL_GENERAL_DESC: Third-party API keys and external directory endpoints
CONFIG_PAGE.DNS_RESOLVER_HINT: DNS resolver IP address for domain and upstream name resolution (e.g. 1.1.1.1 or 127.0.0.11)
CONFIG_PAGE.PANEL_CA_DESC: Manage root CA certificate and private key for client certificates & TLS inspection
CONFIG_PAGE.PANEL_POLICY_DESC: Configure transactional logging targets and database retention purging
CONFIG_PAGE.LOGGING_DESC: Configure how transaction and security audit logs are stored. Logs can be written locally to DuckDB or streamed to an external cluster.
CONFIG_PAGE.LOGGING_MODE_HINT: Storage destination for access and security transaction logs
CONFIG_PAGE.LOGGING_MODE_LOCAL_INFO: Logs are stored locally in the embedded DuckDB database. Fast, self-contained, and requires zero external infrastructure.
CONFIG_PAGE.LOGGING_MODE_ES_INFO: Logs are streamed in real time to the remote Elasticsearch/OpenSearch cluster with dashboard support.
CONFIG_PAGE.SEC_AUDIT_LOG_PARTS_HINT: Select transaction sections to record in the audit log
CONFIG_PAGE.AUDIT_PART_A_DESC: Timestamp, unique transaction ID, client IP and request metadata
CONFIG_PAGE.AUDIT_PART_B_DESC: HTTP method, request URI and all client headers
CONFIG_PAGE.AUDIT_PART_C_DESC: Payload data (POST/PUT body, JSON, forms) when inspection is enabled
CONFIG_PAGE.AUDIT_PART_E_DESC: Response body before WAF transformations are applied
CONFIG_PAGE.AUDIT_PART_F_DESC: Final HTTP status code and server response headers
CONFIG_PAGE.AUDIT_PART_H_DESC: ModSecurity metadata, matched rule IDs and actions taken
CONFIG_PAGE.AUDIT_PART_I_DESC: Alternative to part C excluding large file uploads
CONFIG_PAGE.AUDIT_PART_J_DESC: Information and filenames of uploaded multipart files
CONFIG_PAGE.AUDIT_PART_K_DESC: Complete list of matched security rules in execution order
CONFIG_PAGE.AUDIT_PART_Z_DESC: Closing boundary marking the end of the audit log entry
CONFIG_PAGE.ELASTICSEARCH_SECTION_DESC: Configure remote cluster endpoint and credentials for transaction ingestion
CONFIG_PAGE.DASHBOARD_SECTION_DESC: Configure dashboard visualization URL and user access credentials
CONFIG_PAGE.PURGE_DESC: Automatically delete outdated transactional records from the local DuckDB database to preserve high performance and disk storage.
CONFIG_PAGE.PANEL_IPXA_DESC: Configure IPXA threat intelligence and IP reputation service endpoint
CONFIG_PAGE.IPXA_URL_HINT: Endpoint URL of the IPXA threat intelligence service (e.g. http://ipxa:5000)
CONFIG_PAGE.IPXA_KEY_HINT: Secret API key for authenticating with IPXA service
